usage: Refers to a decorative pendant made of jade; it is a noun and can sound a bit traditional or classy.
Common in cultural, gift, and family contexts, especially when talking about heirlooms, auspicious items, or jewellery.
You can say a 玉佩 is worn around the neck or kept as a personal accessory; it often carries symbolic meaning.
This word is clear and neutral, but in everyday speech people may simply talk about a jade pendant, jade jewellery, or a pendant depending on the context.
